profile.summary: AIMAX Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in gloves and nitrile butadiene latex manufacturing, healthcare, and financial businesses in Malaysia. It operates through Healthcare, Financial Services, and gloves, Seafood Business, and Others segments. The company also offers medical diagnostic and research laboratory services; supplies medical and healthcare products; money lending services; process, trades, retails, and packs seafood and food-related products; and offers genetic research and testing services. It provides financial services. It offers flexible financing schemes to cater for a broader range of customers such as investment holding companies, SMEs, start-up enterprises and more. In addition, it is involved in the construction and operation of tank farm facilities for feedstocks storage and related integrated logistics services; and property development business. The company was formerly known as Hong Seng Consolidated Berhad and changed its name to AIMAX Berhad in June 2026. AIMAX Berhad was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia.
profile.zh: AIMAX Berhad 是一家投资控股公司，总部位于马来西亚 Petaling Jaya，成立于 2001 年，原名 Hong Seng Consolidated Berhad，于 2026 年 6 月更名为现名。公司业务覆盖手套与丁腈胶乳制造、医疗保健、金融服务等多个领域。
lines: 医疗保健：提供医疗诊断与研究实验室服务，并供应医疗及保健产品。
金融服务：提供资金借贷及灵活融资方案，客户包括投资控股公司、中小企业、初创企业等。
手套与丁腈胶乳：从事手套及丁腈胶乳的制造业务。
海产：加工、贸易、零售及包装海产与食品相关产品。
其他：包括用于原料储存的储罐设施建设与运营及相关综合物流服务，以及房地产开发业务。
lines_en: Healthcare: provides medical diagnostic and research laboratory services and supplies medical and healthcare products.
Financial services: offers money lending and flexible financing schemes to investment holding companies, SMEs, start-ups and others.
Gloves and nitrile butadiene latex: manufactures gloves and nitrile butadiene latex.
Seafood: processes, trades, retails and packs seafood and food-related products.
Others: construction and operation of tank farm facilities for feedstock storage with integrated logistics services, and property development.
